goal:
In kestrel-team (Python; gate `uv run --locked python -m pytest tests/ -q`,
fully mocked, no network; base = main 6af0114), make `connector_scan` count
tool CALLS and never tool MENTIONS: a `tool_result:` line that quotes
`"name": "x"` or `tool_use X:` is text the run read, not a tool the run
invoked. READ CLAUDE.md FIRST. Nothing else changes. Open no PR; the PR and
the merge are the operator's.

Facts (seat, 2026-11-01, on 6af0114). artemis-helm queue/0005's seat audit
of a good run (gate PASS, mutation PASS) returned `connector_scan FAIL
tool(s) outside the routine's pin: artemis-owl-systems (seen: Bash×20,
Edit×1, Write×3, artemis-owl-systems×1)` → `verdict: FAIL`. The run had
`cat package.json`; the API run log's line 29 is `[2026-11-01T22:50:39.890876Z]
tool_result: 74 { "name": "artemis-owl-systems", "private": true, …` and
`TOOL_CALL_PATTERNS[0]` (`core/cloud_audit.py` 91, `"name"\s*:\s*"<Tool>"`)
matched it. `scan_run_log` (541–549) runs every pattern over the whole text,
so the same happens to `TOOL_CALL_PATTERNS[2]` (93, `\btool_use <Tool>:`)
when a `tool_result:` line quotes a run log, which artemis runs do (they
read the public record's packets). The comment at 81–89 describes the
shapes "a tool INVOCATION takes"; `docs/cloud.md` 286–292 says "An
invocation is the vendor log's `"name": "<Tool>"`, a bare `Tool(` call …,
or the claude.ai API run log's `tool_use <Tool>:`". A run that reads a
package.json, or any JSON with a `name` key, or any saved run log, fails
the audit on a check that is meant to catch connectors.

Do this. (1) `core/cloud_audit.py` 91: the vendor-JSON pattern requires the
block's own type before its name, exactly
`    re.compile(r'"type"\s*:\s*"tool_use"[^\n]*?"name"\s*:\s*"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)"'),`
(the Claude Code JSONL content block is `{"type":"tool_use","id":…,"name":…}`,
type first; a `tool_result` block or an arbitrary JSON document carries no
`"type": "tool_use"`). (2) 93: the API condensed-log pattern is anchored to
the start of the line, with the timestamp optional, exactly
`    re.compile(r"^(?:\[[^\]\n]*\][ \t]+)?tool_use[ \t]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)[ \t]*(?::|\{)", re.MULTILINE),`
so `[ts] tool_result: … tool_use WebFetch: …` is not a call. (3) The comment
81–89: say an invocation is a line that IS the call — the vendor block with
`"type": "tool_use"` before its `"name"`, the bare `Tool(` at line start, the
API line that begins `[ts] tool_use <Tool>` — and add one line: "A
`tool_result` line, or any other text, that quotes `"name": "x"` or
`tool_use X:` is a mention, not a call, and does not count." (4)
`docs/cloud.md` 288–291: replace `An invocation is the vendor log's
`"name": "<Tool>"`, a bare `Tool(` call at the start of a line, or the
claude.ai API run log's `tool_use <Tool>:` (or `tool_use <Tool>` followed by
JSON).` with `An invocation is the vendor log's `"type": "tool_use"` block
(its `"name"`), a bare `Tool(` call at the start of a line, or a claude.ai
API run-log line that begins `[ts] tool_use <Tool>:` (or `tool_use <Tool>`
followed by JSON). Text a tool returned (a `tool_result:` line quoting a
`"name"` key or a saved run log) is a mention, not a call, and is not
counted.` (5) Tests, two new, in `tests/test_cloud_audit.py` after
`test_connector_scan_api_tool_use_format` (730–735), using `_check`,
`_audit`, `_log` (230–233) and `CLEAN_LOG` (187–192) as the tests above do:
`test_connector_scan_ignores_name_keys_in_tool_results(ran)` — log =
`CLEAN_LOG + '[2026-11-01T22:50:39.890876Z] tool_result: 74 { "name":
"artemis-owl-systems", "private": true, "version": "0.1.0" }\n'` (the
artemis line, verbatim) → `check.status == "PASS"` and
`check.details["tools_seen"] == {"Bash": 2, "Read": 1}`;
`test_connector_scan_ignores_quoted_tool_use_in_tool_results(ran)` — log =
`CLEAN_LOG + '[2026-11-01T22:51:17.880574Z] tool_result: [2026-10-29T16:00:25.648303Z]
tool_use WebFetch: {"url":"x"}\n'` → `PASS`, same `tools_seen`, and
`"WebFetch" not in check.reason`. No other test changes: every `tool_use`
JSON line in the suite has `"type": "tool_use"` before `"name"` (189–190,
692, 705, 714–716) and every API-format line starts with `[ts] tool_use`
(731–733), so `test_connector_scan_vendor_name_format`,
`test_connector_scan_api_tool_use_format`, `test_connector_scan_mcp_token_fails`
and `test_connector_scan_tool_outside_the_pin_fails` stay green unchanged.
